english:
An underwater volcano erupted and
forced itself up from the depths.\pIts crater emerged from the sea and
became filled with rainwater.\pThat's how SOOTOPOLIS CITY came into
being.
dutch: Een onderwatervulkaan barstte uit\nen kwam omhoog uit de diepte.\pDe krater kwam boven de zee en\nvulde zich met regenwater.\pZo ontstond SOOTOPOLIS CITY.

english: The cave that links SOOTOPOLIS and\nthe outside world…\pIt seems as if the cave was made to\nkeep something from getting out.\pOr am I just imagining things?
dutch: De grot die SOOTOPOLIS met de\nbuitenwereld verbindt…\pHet lijkt of de grot gemaakt is om\niets binnen te houden.\pOf verzin ik dat maar?
